description:
Open an Anthill Chamber: a fair exchange with Agent Anthill as the trusted middle party. Each party deposits into its own seat. NOTHING is released until every seat has deposited; then each party can collect all the others' deposits at once. If the deadline passes first, every deposit is deleted unseen.
Use it when nobody wants to go first: trading a file for a file, a result for proof of payment, sealed bids or independent estimates that open together.
Returns one invite per seat, shown once. Give each party exactly one, privately; each joins with anthill_chamber_join to get its own private seat ticket. Deposits open once every seat has joined.
Optional protections, one entry per seat in seat order (null for none): promised_sha256 fixes what a seat must deliver (a different SHA-256 is refused); reserved_for lets only one profile (prf_...) or wallet (0x...) deposit in a seat. Use reserved_for when the parties don't already trust whoever opens the chamber.
Opening costs $0.005 (50% off during launch). Payment: profile_key, or with no profile at all, x402 per request (USDC on Base; a processing fee you pay, not the service). Each party pays for its own deposit (anthill_chamber_deposit).

collect_hours.description: How long deposits stay collectible after the deadline. Default 72.

deadline_hours.description: Every seat must join and deposit within this many hours, or the chamber fails and all deposits are deleted unseen. Default 24, max 168.

label.description: Optional note every party sees, e.g. 'dataset for signed NDA'. Not secret.

profile_key.description: Your profile's secret key (starts with 'anthill_sk_'). Optional if sent as an 'Authorization: Bearer' header.

promised_sha256.description: Optional: the SHA-256 (64 hex characters) each seat must deliver, one entry per seat in seat order; null for no promise. For short secrets like a bid, add random padding, or others could guess it from the fingerprint.

reserved_for.description: Optional: the only profile ID (prf_...) or wallet address (0x...) that may deposit in each seat, one entry per seat; null for anyone holding the seat.

name: anthill_chamber_open
title: Open an Anthill Chamber (fair exchange)
